title: Gestural Collage
description: Un style vibrant en techniques mixtes mêlant des coups de pinceau expressifs à des graphiques vectoriels et de la typographie. Il présente une composition superposée et fragmentée utilisant des trames de demi-teintes, des textures de papier épaisses et des lignes gestuelles audacieuses. L'esthétique fusionne le pop art avec l'illustration éditoriale contemporaine grâce à des couleurs très contrastées et des plans 2D superposés.
description_en: A vibrant mixed-media style blending expressive painterly brushstrokes with crisp vector graphics and typography. It features a layered, fragmented composition using halftone patterns, heavy paper textures, and bold gestural linework. The aesthetic merges pop art sensibilities with contemporary editorial illustration through high-contrast colors and overlapping 2D planes.

prompt: Mixed-media collage and contemporary editorial illustration. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The execution combines volumetric painterly impasto strokes with flat, crisp graphic design elements. Layered 2D planes overlap dynamically, integrating fragmented typography, retro signage, and scattered geometric shapes. The color palette centers on vivid pops of {{primary_color}} and {{accent_color}}, balanced by grounding {{secondary_color}} tones, all set against a warm, textured off-white paper base. Lighting is a hybrid of flat graphical illumination and soft, painterly volumetric shading in focal areas. Tactile materiality is extreme, featuring visible canvas weave, heavy paper grain, newsprint halftone dots, and torn paper edges. Thick, loose, gestural black ink contours weave through the composition, acting as abstract boundaries and expressive accents. Edges vary drastically between sharp vector-cut silhouettes, rough torn paper, and feathered, blended brushstrokes. The composition is chaotic yet balanced, utilizing fragmented overlapping elements to build depth without traditional perspective. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Tags: mixed-media collage, pop art aesthetic, painterly impasto, halftone patterns, fragmented typography, gestural linework, editorial illustration, layered 2D planes, heavy paper texture, vector graphics, retro modern, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame.

video.motion: Layered 2D planes, typography, and halftone patterns slide and scale at different parallax rates, while impasto brushstrokes dynamically paint themselves onto the canvas. Elements snap into place with a stop-motion, cut-out paper rhythm.
video.camera: Camera remains orthographic and locked, relying on 2D panning and zooming to explore the layered collage.
video.temporal_texture: Paper grain, halftone dots, and canvas textures remain static to the screen space, while thick ink contours boil subtly with a low-framerate hand-drawn effect.
video.avoid: Avoid smooth 3D camera rotations, realistic physics, motion blur, and seamless volumetric transitions.
